jobs.title: Social Media Content Creator Intern
jobs.why: This role builds your Administrative, Critical Thinking, creative skills and moves you toward becoming a Arts.
jobs.eligibility_reason: Social media content creation is suitable for minors.
jobs.bridge: As a Social Media Content Creator Intern, you'll sharpen your video-editing and storytelling skills, which directly translate to creating compelling visual narratives for your photography and arts career. Plus, the creative problem-solving you'll practice in adapting content for different platforms builds the adaptability needed to thrive as a content creator.

jobs.title: Werkstudent*in Art Direction & Motion Design (all genders)
jobs.why: This role builds your Administrative, Critical Thinking, creative skills and moves you toward becoming a Arts.
jobs.eligibility_reason: Student assistant in art direction, no age restriction.
jobs.bridge: As a Werkstudent in Art Direction & Motion Design, you'll deepen your graphic design and motion design skills while mastering tools like Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud—directly transferable to creating compelling visual content as a Content Creator or Photographer. Your critical thinking and creative problem-solving will also be sharpened through real-world design critiques, building a strong foundation for your arts career.

steps: Take a free Adobe Suite basics course on LinkedIn Learning to master Photoshop and Lightroom.
Practice creating short videos with Canva and After Effects using online tutorials.
Learn production planning by volunteering for a local event or small project.
Study quality control and safety compliance through OSHA's free online training.
Develop team leadership by leading a small group project or joining a club.
